what_changed: CFPB proposes amending Regulation B: 12 CFR 1002.6(a) would state that ECOA does not provide for the effects test (disparate impact); 1002.4(b) would limit discouragement to statements directed at applicants or prospective applicants that a reasonable person would read as signalling denial or worse terms on a prohibited basis; 1002.8 would add conditions for for-profit special purpose credit programs and bar race, color, national origin or sex as eligibility criteria. Comments due December 15, 2025. Finalized as proposed by 2026-07804 (effective July 21, 2026).
compliant_agent_must_now: No change until final; see 2026-07804, which adopted this proposal without change effective July 21, 2026.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Does the deployment run fair-lending or disparate-impact testing of collection, settlement and hardship outcomes? Will it continue as internal policy, given that state fair-lending laws and other regulators may still apply an effects test?
rationale: Full text (proposed 1002.4(b), 1002.6(a), 1002.8) matches the final rule judged relevant; relevance follows it. Stage B: read SUMMARY, DATES, SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION and any regulatory text from the saved GovInfo full text (1200 of 24768 words).
